messages.author: 60b6b44a6a058fdb
messages.subject: knitr and cloud
parts:
Hi all,

I am running some heavy simulations, which slows down my laptop dramatically. I was wondering if there is a way to write the code in Rstudio, but let it knit on cloud (e.g High performance computer at the university). Thanks in advance!

Qike

messages.author: 8502567f9dbc7c7e
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr and cloud
parts: One solution is to separate the computation from the presentation. Put your computations in an R file, run them at the computing facility of your choice to generate result objects in memory, and save.image to store them. Move the RData file to your workstation and just load the RData file in your Rmd/Rnw file and generate presentable results.

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr and cloud
parts: You don't need rstudio to knit, you can just run an R script that calls `knit("myfile.Rmd")` or what not.  Of course you can also run rstudio in the cloud (e.g. on an amazon web server, though you might ask the maintainers of your university HPC if they would consider supporting rstudio server installation.)
